g.title: Dusk on the cliff path. Maya has climbed the last of the steps; Theo waits by the door. Caption: Port Ellis. The night the lamp went out. MAYA: Theo? The lamp is out -- THEO: -- because somebody forgot the oil. KEEPER, off panel: Who's up there?
Closer. Maya points back down the path, furious. MAYA, shouting: Somebody! THEO, whispering: I was going to fetch it.
Inside, the lamp blazes again. Both of them squint into the light. Sound effect, from THEO: FWOOMP. MAYA, off panel: -- and that was how the harbour got its light back.
